summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 new features: Payees Management, Spending Analytics, and AI Chat. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 3 features accessible and UI working correctly. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: Incorrect import paths in payees.tsx, analytics.tsx, and chat.tsx (used ../../src instead of ../src) - app was completely broken, now fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: All 3 new feature files had incorrect import paths - '../../src/services/api' should be '../src/services/api'. This caused complete app failure with 'Unable to resolve module' error. Fixed in payees.tsx, analytics.tsx, and chat.tsx.
Payees Management: POST /api/payees creates payee with validation (duplicate check), PUT /api/payees/{id} updates payee, proper error handling for 404 and 400
Spending Analytics: GET /api/analytics/spending returns comprehensive data - total spending, transaction count, categories breakdown, top payees, 6-month trend
AI Chat: POST /api/chat integrates with OpenAI via emergentintegrations.llm.chat, provides financial context to AI, stores chat history in MongoDB, session management working
All 3 features accessible from More tab in profile screen with proper navigation
Payee form has proper validation and auto-formatting for sort code (XX-XX-XX format)
Analytics displays data with visual elements (category bars, monthly trend bars, top payees ranking)
Chat has 3 quick action buttons (Last Transaction, Transfer Delays, Support Hours) that send pre-defined queries
All MongoDB _id fields correctly excluded from API responses
All endpoints have proper authentication checks (403 without token)
testID attributes present on all interactive elements for testing
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py - Created comprehensive backend tests for all 3 features
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use existing sorttest@test.com user. Tests create TEST_ prefixed payees for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features tested and working. Import path bug was critical - app wouldn't load at all. Now fixed and all features functional. Backend APIs all working with proper auth, validation, and error handling. Frontend screens load correctly with proper navigation from More tab. AI chat integration working with OpenAI.

rca_of_issue.issue: App showing red error screen 'Unable to resolve module ../../src/services/api from /app/frontend/app/analytics.tsx'
reproduction_steps: 2. App immediately shows red error screen
3. Error message indicates module resolution failure

root_cause_analysis.immediate_cause: Incorrect relative import paths in 3 new feature files
root_cause_analysis.technical_details: Files located at /app/frontend/app/*.tsx were importing from '../../src/services/api' which resolves to /app/src/services/api (incorrect). Correct path is '../src/services/api' which resolves to /app/frontend/src/services/api
root_cause_analysis.why_it_happened: Developer likely assumed app/ was nested deeper in the directory structure, or copy-pasted imports from a different file location

mitigation_steps: 1. Changed import in analytics.tsx from '../../src/services/api' to '../src/services/api'
2. Changed imports in payees.tsx from '../../src/services/api' and '../../src/services/bank-lookup' to '../src/services/api' and '../src/services/bank-lookup'
3. Changed import in chat.tsx from '../../src/services/api' to '../src/services/api'
4. Restarted Expo with 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo'
5. Verified app loads successfully without errors
rca_of_issue.verification: App now loads correctly, all 3 features accessible and functional
